evidence.quote: Newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries have to pay tuition fees of 1,500 € per semester.

notes: Intakes: the DAAD page only says "Application periods Mid-May until mid-September" with no year and no explicit statement that this applies to international/non-EU applicants, so an intake is left out. Tuition is quoted per semester (1,500 EUR), not per year; it applies to international students not from EU/EEA countries. German language: DAAD says A2 required/recommended, no proof required; the official page confirms German/English instruction, so German proficiency is a soft/curricular matter best checked manually.

note.fr: Diplôme étranger : faire reconnaître le bac par Studienkolleg Konstanz ou uni-assist, ou passer l'examen d'admission propre à l'université (TestAS, ITB, SAT+IELTS, ACT+IELTS).
note.en: Foreign certificate: have the school-leaving certificate recognized by Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist, or take the university-specific entrance exam (TestAS, ITB, SAT+IELTS, ACT+IELTS).
